comment: Illustrates C1 in the clinical instance. The draft's only new Goal-3 component is the CDSE, and it labels one CDSE feature "Care coordination." The CDSE is stateless and fires at the point of care, so it cannot detect a non-event — the referral no one actions, the follow-up that never closes. We recommend (a) renaming that feature "Care-plan and pathway guidance," and (b) stating that the CDSE does not coordinate care across systems or over time — pointing to C1. We support the CDSE, scoped to decision support.

public.text: Illustrates C1 in the clinical instance. The draft's only new Goal-3 component is the CDSE, and it labels one CDSE feature "Care coordination." The CDSE is stateless and fires at the point of care, so it cannot detect a non-event — the referral no one actions, the follow-up that never closes. We recommend (a) renaming that feature "Care-plan and pathway guidance," and (b) stating that the CDSE does not coordinate care across systems or over time — pointing to C1. We support the CDSE, scoped to decision support.
